uci_cogsci_electives_evc.description: EVC->UCI Cognitive Sciences: complete 3 semesters/quarters (6 courses recommended) from the options below. CONFIRMED from actual ASSIST PDF, but the precise UCI-course-to-EVC-course row pairing was ambiguous in the extracted text for a couple of these -- flagged per-option below.

options.option_label: Programming series: EVC COMSC 075 + COMSC 076 (2 courses)
EVC MATH 073 (Multivariable Calculus, 5 units)
EVC MATH 079 (Linear Algebra, 3 units)
EVC MATH 078 (Differential Equations, 4 units)
EVC PHYS 007A + PHYS 007B (only 2 courses -- EVC has no 3rd course here). This satisfies UCI's CALCULUS-BASED 'Classical Physics' sequence (PHYSICS 7C/7D/7E) specifically.

UCI ALSO separately accepts an ALGEBRA-based 'Basic Physics' sequence (PHYSICS 3A/3B/3C) as an alternative option -- this is NOT the same course sequence as physics1/2/3 above and is NOT interchangeable with it (confirmed: user verified these are non-equivalent). No EVC course has been confirmed against this specific algebra-based track -- do not assume the calc-based mapping above covers it.
EVC STAT C1000 (or BUS 060)
EVC PHIL 090 (Introduction to Logic) -- no matching slot tracked here
No EVC equivalent exists for any linguistics option (LSCI 3/10/20/51)
No EVC equivalent exists for extra neuro electives (BIO SCI 36/37/38)

uci_cogsci_electives_deanza.description: De Anza->UCI Cognitive Sciences: same 'complete 3 semesters/6 courses' requirement as EVC, but De Anza has MUCH better coverage -- it offers real equivalents for linguistics and logic that EVC doesn't. WARNING: the PHYS2A/2B/2C physics option is flagged in the source PDF as 'Effective next fall, this articulation is no longer valid' -- use the PHYS4A/4B/4C option instead going forward.

options.option_label: Programming series: De Anza CIS 40 + CIS 41A + CIS 41B (3 courses)
De Anza LING 1 (Introduction to Linguistics) -- real equivalent, unlike EVC
De Anza PHIL 7 (Deductive Logic, or 7H honors) -- real equivalent, unlike EVC
De Anza MATH 1D (Calculus IV) -- satisfies UCI's MATH 2D/2E multivariable pair
De Anza MATH 2B (or 2BH)
De Anza MATH 2A (or 2AH) -- note De Anza's OWN numbering: their 'MATH 2A' means Diff Eq, not Calc I

De Anza PHYS 2A/2B/2C (5 units, DEPRECATED next fall) OR PHYS 4A/4B/4C (6 units, use this one going forward). This satisfies UCI's CALCULUS-BASED 'Classical Physics' sequence (PHYSICS 7C/7D/7E) specifically.

UCI ALSO separately accepts an ALGEBRA-based 'Basic Physics' sequence (PHYSICS 3A/3B/3C) as an alternative option -- this is NOT the same course sequence as physics1/2/3 above and is NOT interchangeable with it (confirmed: user verified these are non-equivalent). No De Anza course has been confirmed against this specific algebra-based track -- do not assume the calc-based mapping above covers it.
De Anza STAT C1000 (or Honors), or PSYC 15 / POLI 20 (same as SOC 15)
